name: Tsunami
overview: Scripture reveals God's sovereign control over the seas and their tumultuous waves, as He commands the stormy winds that lift them up and divides the roaring waves of the sea. These powerful natural forces, including tsunamis, serve as reminders of His majesty and authority over creation, often signaling times of distress and divine intervention. The roaring waves and signs in nature point to the fulfillment of prophetic events, underscoring the urgency of heeding God's word and remaining faithful as the time of His promises draws near.
